newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech SPT CZK 984.4 mln Q1 net profit.
newsitem.headline: Czech SPT CZK 984.4 mln Q1 net profit.

text.p: Results for first quarter ending March 31, 1997, calculated according to Czech accounting standards:
Note. Full company name is SPT Telecom a.s.
Results were supplied by the Prague Stock Exchange, and are calculated according to Czech accounting standards.
In April, SPT said that according to international accounting standards (IAS), its revenues for the first three months rose to 9.04 billion crowns from 7.34 billion for the same period last year.
But net profit edged down to 1.59 billion from a previous 1.75 billion after depreciation charges rose some 34 percent to 1.83 billion crowns, and staff costs grew by 18 percent to 1.59 billion.

In June 1995, the Czech government chose a joint bid from the TelSource consortium formed by Koninklijke PTT Nederland and Swiss Telecom, from among five global telecom bids for a 27 percent stake, and effective operating control of the firm.
The group -- split between 51 percent for the Dutch PTT, and 49 percent for Swiss Telecom -- paid $1.32 billion for the shares, plus an additional $131 million in training services and technology.
